first_profiles.name: Bijay Mohanty
first_profiles.draft: Bijay Mohanty's contribution reaches beyond the familiar face on screen. Trained at the National School of Drama, he worked in theatre and later taught drama at Utkal Sangeet Mahavidyalaya. His films range from Chilika Tire to Nagaphasa and Chaka Bhaunri. The same career connects performance, teaching and the practical work of sustaining a theatrical culture. Chilika Tire's National Film Award belongs to the film; it should not be presented as a personal national acting award for Mohanty.

sources.supports: NSD graduate; 1977 Chilika Tire; film won National Award; named films; drama department and retirement as professor.
Reports NSD registrar's tribute identifying 1973 graduating batch and student productions.
Manoj Pattanaik remembers his play Amari Bhagaban staged by Manan Natya Sangstha; Sabyasachi Mishra remembers playing his son.

first_profiles.limits: Do not make first/sole/superlative claims. Award totals not independently checked against original state award orders. Birthplace/date variations need not enter this short contribution profile.

first_profiles.name: Uttam Mohanty
first_profiles.draft: Uttam Mohanty's 1977 debut Abhiman also connects two generations of this story: Sadhu Meher directed it. Recalling the beginning in 2018, Mohanty described meeting Meher, being photographed and trying to fit the film into a holiday from his studies. His later screen work included Jhiati Sita Pari, Danda Balunga and Suna Chadhei. One memory mattered particularly to him: a Bengali viewer in Cuttack praised his portrayal of Salabega. It is a modest, specific account of a performance travelling beyond its immediate linguistic audience.

sources.supports: Debut; named films; first-person casting and audience recollection; count in introductory paragraph, not his own count.

first_profiles.limits: This source is already used in overview and Sadhu profile. Coordinate remaining 200-word package budget before adding the full draft. Conflicting age/birth reports omitted. One viewer's response is not proof of general Bengali reception.

first_profiles.name: Aparajita Mohanty
first_profiles.draft: Aparajita Mohanty's career should be told through her work as an actor and producer, rather than only through her family. Udandi Sita belongs among the films associated with her long screen career. Her move into producing Love Master is another part of that work. A different connection emerges in her remembrance of Anita Das: Aparajita described the senior actor as an elder-sister figure who taught her acting and the workings of the industry. That testimony makes room for the mentorship between women that a star-centred history can miss.

sources.supports: More than100 films; Udandi Sita; count not language-separated.
